forms.exact: What does contract NW-55-1182 cover?

forms.exact: What caused ERR_QUEUE_SATURATED: shard 7 exceeded 40000 pending jobs, and what was changed?
forms.paraphrase: Why did work pile up faster than the scheduler could drain it, and what did we change?

gold_answer.text: The billing worker retried failed invoice exports with no backoff, and each retry fanned out into three jobs. Retries now back off exponentially and stop after five attempts.

required_facts.fact: The billing worker retried failed invoice exports with no backoff.
Retries now back off exponentially and stop after five attempts.

forms.exact: Why did every sign-in fail with JWT verification failed: kid 'k-2026-03' not found in JWKS?
forms.paraphrase: Why could nobody sign in after we changed the token signing keys?

gold_answer.text: The identity service started signing tokens with the new key before the gateways had refreshed their cached key set, so the gateways rejected every new token.

required_facts.fact: The identity service signed with the new key before the gateways refreshed their cached key set.

forms.exact: What caused ENOSPC: no space left on device, write '/var/lib/ingest/spool'?
forms.paraphrase: Why did that server's storage fill up during the ingest outage?

gold_answer.text: Log rotation had been disabled during a migration and never turned back on, so debug logs filled the volume over eleven days.

required_facts.fact: Log rotation was disabled during a migration and never turned back on.

forms.exact: Why does ADR-007 choose Postgres over MongoDB?
